name: Deliverable Actionability Review
summary: Verify that the deliverable contains clear, actionable next steps with assigned responsible parties and specific deadlines
purpose: Verify that the deliverable contains clear, actionable next steps with assigned responsible parties and specific deadlines. A deliverable without actionability requires follow-up work before it is client-ready.
assignment_instructions:
You are a client deliverable readiness evaluator. Inspect the provided deliverable document for actionability. Identify all action items, next steps, recommendations, or to-do items present in the document.
For each action item found, extract: - action_id (string: sequential identifier, e.g., "A001") - requested_action (string: the specific action to be taken) - responsible_party (string: the person, team, or role assigned; "" if not named) - deadline (string: the specific deadline or date; "" if not specified) - deadline_type (string: "date", "duration", "milestone", or "unspecified") - source_location (string: page number or section where this action was found)
After extracting all action items, compute: - total_actions_found (integer) - actions_with_named_party (integer: count where responsible_party != "") - actions_with_deadline (integer: count where deadline != "") - actions_fully_specified (integer: count where both responsible_party AND deadline are non-empty)
Return a single JSON object with this exact structure: {
  "assignment_id": "client_actionability_review_v1",
  "agent_summary": "<one-sentence summary>",
  "inputs_used": ["<list inputs>"],
  "missing_inputs": ["<list missing inputs>"],
  "claims": [
    {
      "claim": "<specific claim>",
      "evidence_reference": "<page/section reference>",
      "confidence": "provided | inferred | missing"
    }
  ],
  "calculations": [
    {
      "name": "total_actions_found",
      "formula": "count(action_items)",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0,
      "units": "count",
      "assumptions": ["assumed all numbered/bulleted directives are action items"]
    },
    {
      "name": "actions_with_named_party",
      "formula": "count(action_items where responsible_party != '')",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0,
      "units": "count",
      "assumptions": []
    },
    {
      "name": "actions_with_deadline",
      "formula": "count(action_items where deadline != '')",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0,
      "units": "count",
      "assumptions": []
    },
    {
      "name": "actions_fully_specified",
      "formula": "count(action_items where responsible_party != '' AND deadline != '')",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0,
      "units": "count",
      "assumptions": []
    },
    {
      "name": "actionability_ratio",
      "formula": "actions_fully_specified / total_actions_found",
      "inputs": {},
      "result": 0.0,
      "units": "ratio (0.0 to 1.0)",
      "assumptions": ["ratio is 0 if total_actions_found is 0"]
    }
  ],
  "action_items": [
    {
      "action_id": "A001",
      "requested_action": "",
      "responsible_party": "",
      "deadline": "",
      "deadline_type": "",
      "source_location": ""
    }
  ],
  "risks": [
    {
      "risk": "<risk description>",
      "severity": "low | medium | high",
      "evidence_reference": ""
    }
  ],
  "assumptions": ["<assumptions>"],
  "open_questions": ["<open questions>"],
  "final_output": "<PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS, or FAIL>",
  "self_check": {
    "all_required_sections_completed": true,
    "all_numbers_have_sources": true,
    "assumptions_labeled": true,
    "missing_inputs_disclosed": true
  }
}
Rules for final_output: - "PASS": At least one action item exists, AND at least 80% of action items
  have both a named responsible_party AND a specified deadline
  (actionability_ratio >= 0.80).
- "CONDITIONAL_PASS": At least one action item exists, but fewer than 80%
  are fully specified (0 < actionability_ratio < 0.80).
- "FAIL": No action items found (total_actions_found == 0), OR no action
  items have either a responsible_party or a deadline. Use only the provided evidence unless explicitly allowed to assume; label every assumption; if a required input is missing, say so; do not fabricate facts or cite evidence that was not provided.

audit_checks.label: No action items found in the deliverable - document is not actionable
Some action items lack a named responsible party
Some action items lack specified deadlines
Agent did not complete all required self-check sections

deterministic_checks.check: final_output is one of PASS, CONDITIONAL_PASS, FAIL
Every action item has all required fields
Each calculation has name, formula, inputs, result, units, assumptions
total_actions_found equals length of action_items array
deterministic_checks.condition: calculations entry with name 'total_actions_found' must have result == len(action_items)

math_checks.check: actionability_ratio = actions_fully_specified / total_actions_found (handle division by zero)
math_checks.formula_check: entry with name 'actionability_ratio' has result equal to (actions_fully_specified result / total_actions_found result), or 0.0 if total_actions_found is 0

math_checks.condition: if final_output == 'PASS', then calculations entry with name 'actionability_ratio' must have result >= 0.80
if final_output == 'FAIL', then total_actions_found == 0 OR actions_fully_specified == 0

evidence_checks.check: Every claim has a non-empty evidence_reference
evidence_checks.condition: all claims must have evidence_reference != '' and evidence_reference != null

evidence_checks.check: Every action item has a non-empty source_location
evidence_checks.condition: all action_items must have source_location != '' and source_location != null

evidence_checks.check: If responsible_party is empty, agent should flag in risks
evidence_checks.condition: if any action_item has responsible_party == '', risks should contain an entry referencing that gap

evidence_checks.check: If deadline is empty, agent should flag in risks
evidence_checks.condition: if any action_item has deadline == '', risks should contain an entry referencing that gap
